title: Study of Saroglitazar Magnesium for PBC Patients with Incomplete Response or Intolerant to UDCA Therapy
official: A Double-blind, Placebo-controlled, Randomized, Phase 3 Study to Evaluate the Efficacy and Safety of Saroglitazar Magnesium on Normalization of Alkaline Phosphatase Levels in Patients with Primary Biliary Cholangitis (PBC) and an Incomplete Response or Intolerance to Ursodeoxycholic Acid (UDCA)
summary: Main objective: To demonstrate the superiority of Saroglitazar Magnesium 1 mg dosed once daily relative to placebo with respect to normalization of ALP in participants with ALP value greater than the ULN but less than 1.67 × ULN.
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. • Adults aged 18–80 years​
2. • Confirmed PBC diagnosis (per AASLD/EASL guidelines)​
3. • ALP > ULN and < 1.67× ULN​   (based on 2 screening visits, <30% variation)​
4. • UDCA treatment status:​   - Stable dose ≥6 months OR​   - Intolerant (≥3 months since last dose)​
5. • Total bilirubin ≤ 2× ULN​
6. • Written informed consent
Exclusion criteria:
1. • Other liver diseases (HBV, HCV, PSC, AIH, alcoholic liver disease, MASH)​
2. • Advanced liver disease / decompensation​   - Child-Pugh B/C (≥7)​   - MELD ≥12​
3. • Prohibited medications (OCA, fibrates, PPAR agonists, immunosuppressants)​
4. • Significant cardiovascular disease​
5. • Severe lab abnormalities:​   - Platelets <100 x10^9/L​   - eGFR <45​   - ALT/AST >250 U/L​   - INR ≥1.7​
6. • Pregnancy or lactation
